summary.text: Anthony Thornton is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 19, which covers parts of Bernalillo, Sandoval, Santa Fe and Torrance counties.
Thornton sits on the Senate Conservation Committee and the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Thornton's legislative page lists a district office in Cedar Crest.
Between sessions, Thornton is a member of the Land Grant Committee and the Science, Technology and Telecommunications Committee.
